The '''Box''' was an enormous structure constructed by the mastermind criminal [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] at [[Dooku's palace/Legends|Dooku's palace]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It was made to test the skill of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], for which purpose Eval and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] employed it during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The Box is a challenge simulator made of shifting panels, and behind those panels is lots and lots of pain in one form or another.|[[Arack Dostryt|Arack "Deadeye" Dostryt]] on the Box|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code" />}}
The Box took the form of a cube with several internal cubical rooms. Each room was outfitted with a given set of puzzle traps, ranging from [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] to [[Electrified laser blade/Legends|electrified laser blades]], [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] walls and [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. There was a total of five levels. The configuration of these rooms could be controlled from a command center located either somewhere within or nearby the structure or from a controller mounted on Moralo Eval's wrist.

==History==
{{Quote|Your box does not appear to be as much of a challenge as I thought. Perhaps I should put Hardeen in charge of the mission.''"<br />"''But, this was my plan. You promised me the lead role.''"<br />"''You have one last test to change my mind.''"<br />"''Do not fear, Count Dooku. I will show you who is weak.|Count Dooku and Eval discussing who will lead the mission to kidnap Palpatine|<ref name="The Box" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], bounty hunters [[Sinrich/Legends|Sinrich]], [[Jakoli/Legends|Jakoli]], [[Mantu/Legends|Mantu]], [[Onca/Legends|Onca]], [[Kiera Swan/Legends|Kiera Swan]], and [[Sixtat/Legends|Sixtat]] lost their lives during a [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|competition]]. The only five survivors would then be the ones who participate in the plot against [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
[[File:TheBox-BHC.png|thumb|250px|right|The Box was used by the Bounty Hunters' Guild to initiate new recruits.]]
The Box was later acquired by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] and during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], new applicants to the Guild were required to survive the Box as part of an initiation test. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] believed it to later come under the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who used it as a source of entertainment and torturing enemies.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code" />
